title: Finite etale covers and morphisms descend to finite subextensions
statement:
Let $K$ be a field and $L/K$ a separable algebraic extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $K$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every intermediate field $K\subseteq E\subseteq L$ with $[E:K]<\infty$, put $X_E=X_0\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}E$, and put $X_L=X_0\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}L$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Finite etale covers and their morphisms mean [def-galois-categories].

(1) For every finite etale cover $P\to X_L$ there are such a field $E$, a finite etale cover $P_E\to X_E$, and an isomorphism $P_E\times_{X_E}X_L\cong P$ over $X_L$.

(2) If $P_E,Q_E$ are finite etale covers of $X_E$ and $f:P_E\times_{X_E}X_L\to Q_E\times_{X_E}X_L$ is any $X_L$-morphism, there is a finite intermediate field $E'$ containing $E$ and an $X_{E'}$-morphism $f_{E'}:P_E\times_{X_E}X_{E'}\to Q_E\times_{X_E}X_{E'}$ whose base change is $f$.

(3) If two $X_E$-morphisms $f_E,h_E:P_E\to Q_E$ have equal base changes to $X_L$, their base changes to $X_{E'}$ agree for some finite intermediate field $E'$ containing $E$.

source.place: Tag 0BTV, label lemma-limit: equivalence of the filtered colimit of finite-etale cover categories with the cover category of the limit; specialized to X_E over finite intermediate fields of a separable algebraic extension. Objects, morphisms and eventual equality are the explicit meaning of this categorical equivalence.
